name: spireagent-project
description: Unified STS2 environment, project operations and STPD research workspace

scripts.check:ci: node --test tools/check-ci-contract.test.mjs tools/check-plan.test.mjs tools/check-receipt.test.mjs && node tools/check-ci-contract.mjs
scripts.check:boundaries: node --test tools/check-boundaries.test.mjs tools/workshop-boundary.test.mjs tools/workshop-stage.test.mjs tools/workshop-prepare.test.mjs tools/workshop-publish.test.mjs tools/workshop-uploader.test.mjs && node tools/check-boundaries.mjs
scripts.check:components: npm --prefix components/connector run check && npm --prefix components/host-runtime run check && npm --prefix components/annotator run test && npm --prefix components/evidence run check && npm --prefix components/policy-runtime run check && npm --prefix apps/workbench run test && npm --prefix apps/ingame-ui run check && npm --prefix apps/game-mod run check
scripts.check: npm run project:check && npm run check:governance && npm run check:ci && npm run check:identity && npm run check:entrypoints && npm run check:bom && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:history && npm run check:components && npm run check:python
scripts.check:exact-game: npm --prefix components/connector run check && npm --prefix components/connector run build && npm --prefix components/annotator run check && npm --prefix apps/game-mod run build
scripts.build: npm --prefix components/policy-runtime run build && npm --prefix apps/game-mod run build
scripts.workbench: uv run --project python --locked --extra cloud python python/tools/open_workbench.py
scripts.check:python: uv run --project python --locked python python/tools/project.py check
scripts.check:platform: npm run project:check && npm run check:governance && npm run check:ci && npm run check:identity && npm run check:entrypoints && npm run check:bom && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:history && npm run check:components
scripts.check:docs: npm run project:check && npm run check:governance && git diff --check
scripts.check:repository: npm run project:check && npm run check:governance && npm run check:ci && npm run check:identity && npm run check:entrypoints && npm run check:bom && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:history
scripts.check:python-scope: npm run check:repository && npm run check:python
